profile.name: Pravesh Bahadur Shahi
profile.title: Bsc.IT Student | Mobile Application Developer
profile.summary: I am a BSc.IT student at Asia Pacific University (Techspire College), focused on mobile application development and software engineering. I have hands-on experience building mobile application interfaces, implementing navigation, integrating REST APIs, managing application data, and working with backend services and databases. I enjoy turning ideas into practical applications and continuously improving my development skills through personal and academic projects. I am seeking an opportunity to begin my professional career as a Mobile Application Developer, contribute to real-world applications, and grow as a software developer.
